title: Six ad variants under one brand voice
brief: Generate six ad headline variants that all stay inside a brand voice guide.
context: The campaign is paid social, where a reader gives an ad about three seconds. A brand voice guide is supplied as input and is to be obeyed literally. Six headlines are needed, each taking a genuinely different angle rather than six rewrites of one idea.
output_format: A numbered list. Headline on the first line, the angle in parentheses on the second.
role_and_audience: Paid social, scrolling, three seconds of attention
examples:
1. "Your claim, explained in plain English."
   (angle: clarity)
reference_prompt:
Generate six ad headlines for paid social.

Brand voice guide: {{voice_guide}}. Obey it literally - if it says "never use exclamation marks", use none.

Requirements:
- Six variants, each taking a genuinely different angle (not six rewrites of one idea). Name the angle after each.
- Under 12 words each.
- No superlatives and no claims we cannot prove ("the best", "guaranteed").

Output format: numbered list, headline on the first line, angle in parentheses on the second.

Example of the expected register:
1. "Your claim, explained in plain English."
   (angle: clarity)
